note: Bancroft land case file PDFs held by the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine, crawled before digicoll went behind an AWS WAF bot challenge. A free, open, unauthenticated source; not a way around the challenge, which is neither touched nor defeated here.
caveats: warc_bytes is the WARC record length, NOT the PDF size. Do not infer completeness from it; check for the %%EOF trailer after downloading.
The id_ modifier in replay_url is required. Without it the Wayback Machine injects a banner and the bytes are not a valid PDF.
Some captures are partial. nd102 replays exactly 1,048,576 bytes.
